name: Colin Gradia
original_name: コリン・グレイディーア
source:
A pilot who's considered elite, though he hasn't actually participated in actual fighting, just practice maneuvers.
He acts flirty and aimless, but he can be surprisingly sharp at times.
His rank is first lieutenant.
